claims.nodeLabel: PURSUE - Presidential Unsealing and Reporting System for UAP Encounters
claims.text: The originator-prefixed numbering (DOW-, ODNI-, FBI-) indicates the tranches were assembled by pulling from multiple agencies' holdings under a single presidential tasking rather than compiled from one department's files. Reasoning: a single-department dump would not need agency prefixes, and ODNI-UAP-D001 is an ODNI-originated document published in a DoW release series.
FBI file 62-HQ-83894, the Bureau's master flying disc file spanning 1947-1968, was released as a single 101MB PDF.

claims.sourceText: Disclosure Archives inventory compiled from the war.gov/UFO Release 01 posting
claims.text: Release 01 comprised 160 files - 117 PDFs, 29 sensor videos, 14 photographs - spanning 1944 to 2026.
DOW-UAP-PR051 shows a 2021 MQ-9 Reaper weapons-quality lock on an object exhibiting instantaneous acceleration; DOW-UAP-PR055 shows a spherical object over Afghanistan on 23 November 2020.
ODNI-UAP-D001 is a first-person narrative by a serving senior intelligence officer describing a one-hour, multi-witness UAP encounter from a military helicopter in late 2025.
Release 02 includes a March 2022 sequence of spheres entering and leaving the water near a surfaced US submarine and the February 2023 Lake Huron F-16C engagement.
